title: DevopsTestProvider - Data API
description: Stores the configuration and metadata of both internal and external testing providers integrated with the DevOps framework. It serves as a central registry of supported test providers, maintaining provider-specific information such as implementation identifiers, language settings, URLs, and integration details required to connect and manage external testing systems within DevOps processes. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

ApexClassIdentifier.description: Stores the identifier of the Apex class used to implement the test provider integration.

Description.description: Stores additional details or notes about the test provider.

DeveloperName.description: Stores the unique developer name used to identify the test provider.

Icon.description: Stores icon information or metadata associated with the test provider.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: Specifies the localized language and regional locale code used for the test execution context or report generation. This ensures that any logs, system-generated error messages, or feedback from the DevOps pipeline stage are parsed and presented in the correct linguistic format. Possible values are: da—Danish de—German en_US—English es—Spanish es_MX—Spanish (Mexico) fi—Finnish fr—French it—Italian ja—Japanese ko—Korean nl_NL—Dutch no—Norwegian pt_BR—Portuguese (Brazil) ru—Russian sv—Swedish th—Thai zh_CN—Chinese (Simplified) zh_TW—Chinese (Traditional)

LearnMoreUrl.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LearnMoreUrl.description: Stores a URL that provides additional information or documentation about the test provider.

MasterLabel.description: Stores the display label of the test provider.

NamespacePrefix.description: Stores the namespace prefix associated with the test provider package, if applicable.

TestProviderUrl.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TestProviderUrl.description: Stores the URL used to access or integrate with the external test provider.
